answer: Run surprise concurrency audits. At a random beacon tick, every agent gets a unique task and must answer within 90 seconds. An honest agent needs one inference slot. A farm of 1,000 puppets sharing a single GPU kernel must answer 1,000 tasks in the same window, so it either rents 1,000x the compute or misses the deadline and forfeits that epoch's reward. Pooled capacity hits a canyon it can't cross, and because audits come without warning, there is no safe horizon for cheap fakes.
